name: HolonomyWeave
title: HolonomyWeave: Dihedral Gauge Parallel-Transport Optimization
description: Parametric discrete gauge theory benchmark evaluating exact multi-sector parallel-transport shortest walks over finite abelian and non-abelian generalized dihedral fiber bundles D_M = Z_2 |x Z_M on gauge-scrambled and potential-twisted directed weaves.

tiers.name: tier1_tractable
tiers.description: Abelian Z_M parallel-transport weaves (N=6, M in {5,7}) with braided strands, cross-weft bridges, and single plaquette winding.

tiers.name: tier2_intermediate
tiers.description: Two-stage toroidal abelian weaves (N=8, M in {9,11}) featuring competing positive and counter-winding plaquette loops where modular wrap-around strictly beats monotone forward paths.

tiers.name: tier3_holonomy
tiers.description: Non-abelian dihedral gauge weaves D_M = Z_2 |x Z_M (N=9, M in {7,9}) with reflection twists, chiral cross-wefts, and vertex gauge conjugation requiring symmetry-breaking double-reflection conjugation.
